ALTER PROCEDURE D360.SP_hash_log_DEP
AS

-------------------------DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(float,COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(float,FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT)),0) FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(float,LIEN_AMT)),0) LIEN_AMT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(float,TS_CNT)),0) TS_CNT_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_src
, LIEN_AMT LIEN_AMT_src
, TS_CNT TS_CNT_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_DEP_ACCOUNTLIEN WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_tgt
, LIEN_AMT_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_src
, LIEN_AMT_src
, TS_CNT_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT *
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_src
, LIEN_AMT_src
, TS_CNT_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, FUTURE_ULIEN_AMT_tgt
, LIEN_AMT_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');
